title: Season 4 just started in Crownlands, and players are already racing to claim the map ⚔️
author: explocion200
selftext:
We’ve just kicked off Season 4 of our medieval strategy game, Crownlands, and this screenshot pretty much sums up the opening rush. Armies everywhere, players grabbing key positions, and everyone trying to get their banner on the map.

If you enjoy building a kingdom, capturing territory, and coordinating attacks with a clan, come join us while the season is still getting started.

You begin with one city. Where you go from there is up to you:

\- Build your army and expand your territory.

\- Scout rivals and choose your battles.

\- Join a clan and fight together for Strongholds and the Crown Citadel.

\- Defend what you’ve taken—your next move matters, but so does everyone else’s.

Free to play in your browser on desktop or mobile. No download needed.

New players and returning rulers are welcome. We’d love to see a few more banners in the fight.

👉 Join Season 4 —[ Play Crownlands](http://playcrownlands.com/play)
